response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT s.zoneref, si.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_press, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_press) AS avg_compression_ratio, AVG(avg_size_per_min) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM grouped;
